name: Facebook Ads
shortInfo: Measure ad campaign performance on Facebook.
brief: This Connector enables streaming relevant Facebook Ads performance data into a user determined warehouse. Reporting on various performance metrics relevant to the advertisement forms an integral part of most Advertisement applications. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
about:
Create and run campaigns using simple self-serve tools, and track their performance with easy-to-read reports. More than two billion people use Facebook every month – so no matter what kind of audience you want to reach, you'll find them here.

Learn more about [Facebook Ads API documentation.](https://en-gb.facebook.com/business/ads)
availableData:
